$comment: Completion bar for #44: src/App.tsx held the Ask home, notes rail, note peek, chat and settings in one 2,781-line component with ~20 effects. The split extracts the pure helpers/constants/types into src/domain.ts and each UI feature into its own presentational component under src/features/ (TopBar, NotesRail, FindPanel, ChatView, PromptsView, NotePeek, AiSettingsDialog, ContentChrome), with App.tsx left as the state-owning orchestrator that composes them. Criteria 1-9 fail before the split (the files do not exist); 10 asserts App.tsx actually shrank below 1,300 lines (it was 2,783); 11-12 guard the renderer typecheck and build (the CI gates). Behaviour is unchanged; no test mounts the renderer yet (CONTRIBUTING), so a manual npm run dev pass is stated in the PR. Extracting the shared state into hooks is a follow-up increment, out of scope here.
